description: 0xSero EXL3 pack of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash: every backbone routed expert (layers 0-39, 15,360 experts) re-encoded as EXL3 trellis (MUL1 codebook) at a per-expert K2/K3/K5 mix, 2.77 bpw average; attention, shared experts, routers, Engram tables, DSpark/MTP draft layers, vision tower, embeddings and head are the upstream checkpoint byte for byte. Weights MIT (DeepSeek).
